title: Restore proof
summary: A pending host abort retains custody until cleanup is proven. After stopping a failed runner, its lease holder or a covering steering seat may reset every held host to the interrupted baseline. Only successful same-lease, same-machine reset receipts after cancellation permit normal abort settlement; pre-case heartbeat never marks the next case in flight. Host admission binds the cursor; its subsequent check-in marks host work in flight, while admission alone requires no restoration.
